scenarios.name: delete-type-from-request-only
scenarios.why: the policy details in the COMMAREA play no part: only the key fields are moved

notes: GenApp's VSAM 'delete policy' (LGDPVS01, LINKed by LGDPDB01): WF-POLICY-KEY = CA-REQUEST-ID(4:1) + CA-CUSTOMER-NUM + CA-POLICY-NUM, then EXEC CICS DELETE FILE('KSDSPOLY') RIDFLD(WF-Policy-Key) KEYLENGTH(21); on NORMAL it GOBACKs. Each scenario's KSDSPOLY is compared after the task. Every non-NORMAL RESP in this program goes to WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE, whose first act is EXEC CICS LINK PROGRAM('LGSTSQ') (GenApp's TS/TD error logger, defined in the CSD); the equivalence harness runs one program and has no port of LGSTSQ, so a scenario that reaches it is refused (Unsupported: LINK PROGRAM(LGSTSQ)). The error paths -- NOTFND for a key not on file, NOTOPEN / IOERR / DISABLED, CA-RETURN-CODE '81' -- are therefore NOT exercised here; they need LGSTSQ modelled (or ported) first. Keys: WF-POLICY-KEY is the request-type byte followed by 20 digits, so every key mixes a letter and digits; No browse is issued, so no key order is exercised (the comparison sorts each side's records by key bytes). Data: ksdspoly.txt is built from GenApp's own sample policies (base/cntl/db2cre.jcl's policy rows joined with their endowment / house / motor / commercial rows), laid out as WF-POLICY-INFO (request-type letter + customer + policy number, then the type's 43 bytes) -- the record LGAPVS01 writes; policy 7 (type C, no commercial row) is left out.
